source: ABC Company travel policy: flights (sample data)
text: ABC Company travel policy: flights (sample data) — Class of travel: All domestic flights are booked in Economy. Business class is allowed only for flights longer than 6 hours, with approval from a Vice President.

source: ABC Company travel policy: flights (sample data)
text: ABC Company travel policy: flights (sample data) — When to book: Book flights at least 7 days before travel where possible. Bookings made less than 48 hours before departure need a short note from the traveller's manager explaining why.

source: ABC Company travel policy: flights (sample data)
text: ABC Company travel policy: flights (sample data) — Approval for extra cost: Any change that adds more than ₹3,000 per traveller (change fee plus fare difference) needs the manager's approval before the travel desk confirms it. Changes up to ₹3,000 per traveller can be made directly.

source: ABC Company travel policy: flights (sample data)
text: ABC Company travel policy: flights (sample data) — Changes close to departure: Date changes within 24 hours of departure are handled by the travel desk, not the assistant, because seat availability and fees change quickly.

Airport and airline rules (sample data) — Baggage allowance (luggage): On domestic Economy fares, each traveller can carry one cabin bag up to 7 kg and check in one bag (checked luggage) up to 15 kg. Extra baggage is paid by the company only if the trip needs it, for example equipment for a client visit, and the manager approves it before travel.

Airport and airline rules (sample data) — Web check-in: Web check-in opens 48 hours before departure and closes 60 minutes before departure. Airport check-in counters close 45 minutes before departure. Travellers should reach the airport at least 2 hours before a domestic flight.

Airport and airline rules (sample data) — ID needed at the airport: Carry a valid government photo ID, such as Aadhaar, passport, driving licence or voter ID. The name on the ID must match the name on the ticket.

Airport and airline rules (sample data) — Name corrections: Names on tickets cannot be changed to a different person. A small spelling correction of up to 3 letters can be requested through the travel desk. Anything larger means cancelling and booking again, and the cancellation fee applies.

source: ABC Company travel policy: hotels (sample data)
text: ABC Company travel policy: hotels (sample data) — Approved hotels and nightly limits: Book company-approved hotels. The nightly limit including taxes is ₹7,000 in Bangalore, ₹8,000 in Delhi, ₹8,500 in Bombay and ₹6,500 in Hyderabad. Stays above the limit need the manager's approval.

source: ABC Company travel policy: hotels (sample data)
text: ABC Company travel policy: hotels (sample data) — Hotel check-in and check-out times: At the hotel, standard check-in is 2 pm and check-out is 12 noon. Early check-in and late check-out depend on availability, and the hotel may charge for half a day.

source: ABC Company travel policy: hotels (sample data)
text: ABC Company travel policy: hotels (sample data) — Hotel changes and cancellations: Hotel stays can usually be cancelled free up to 24 hours before check-in. After that, the hotel may charge one night. If a flight date changes, the linked hotel stay should be moved too.

Refunds, expenses and insurance (sample data) — Refund timelines: Refunds for cancelled flights and hotels go back to the company card used for the booking, usually within 5 to 7 working days. Non-refundable fares may return only taxes and fees.
Refunds, expenses and insurance (sample data) — Meals and daily allowance: Travellers get a daily allowance of ₹1,500 for meals on domestic trips. Alcohol is not reimbursed.
Refunds, expenses and insurance (sample data) — Local travel: Airport and local cabs booked through the company cab app are paid directly. Other local travel can be claimed with receipts.

Refunds, expenses and insurance (sample data) — Travel insurance: All employees are covered by the company's group travel insurance for work trips. Report any incident to the travel desk within 48 hours.
